column2: Host-side panel/Twitter Space (Harjeet's "Finding Truth With Harjeet"), not a Kiriakou interview. Kiriakou never appears live; the host replays a handful of short clips (~2-3 sentences, repeated verbatim multiple times) lifted from a separate Chris Hedges interview, then the host and ~15 panel speakers (Max Steel, Marshall, Simran, Dharma, Captain, Coin, Falcon, Akali Ji, Daku, Dr. Sharma, etc.) spend 2.5 hours discussing Air India Flight 182, Khalistan, Indian intelligence, and tangential geopolitics. The only Kiriakou words present are the replayed fragments: (1) "Look at the Greek military junta... Look at Israel... Or we could even point the finger at the government of India... for carrying out assassinations and terrorist attacks in Canada, blowing up a 747, no less" and (2) "the Indians support their own Kashmiri separatist groups... it's the Indians that blew up the 747 in Canada. It's the Indians that carry out hits or attempted hits against Sikh activists or Indian leftists or anti-Hindu nationalists in places like Canada or the UK. There's plenty of blame to go around," plus a brief aside "In 1975, the president signed an executive order banning the CIA from going around the world assassinating people." These are pre-existing statements already sourced verbatim from the Hedges interview elsewhere; nothing here is a new utterance by Kiriakou in this transcript. Per extraction rules (host-side show, panel where he barely speaks), no findings TSV rows produced.
